options.name: batch
options.description: Batch can be used to perform multiple operations in a single module call. Expects a list of the location(s) of the IMS Program Specification Block (PSB) source to be compiled. The source can reference a PDS or PDSE member, sequential data set or UNIX System Services file path.

options.name: dest
options.description: The target output PSBLIB partitioned data set in which the PSB members will be generated.

options.name: location
options.description: The PSB source location, Supported options are DATA_SET or USS. The default is DATA_SET. The DATA_SET option can be used for a PDS, PDSE, or sequential data set.

options.name: member_list
options.description: A list of member names if the source specified is a data set. Optionally, proceeding the source_member, a colon with a target name for the generated PSB member can be specified. If no target name is specified, source_name will be used as the target name. If 'member_list' is empty and location is set to 'DATA_SET' or not specified, then src is expected to be a sequential data set. Elements are of the list are str or dict with single key-value pair

options.name: psb_name
options.description: Target name of the generated PSB member. This parameter is only required and applies if src is a sequential data set.

options.name: replace
options.description: When 'replace' is 'true', an existing PSB member matching the name in the input PSB source will be overwitten.

options.name: src
options.description: The src field can reference a PDS, PDSE member, sequential data set, or UNIX System Services file path. If a PDS is specified, all members within the PDS will be treated as individual PSB source members to be processed.

options.name: sys_lib
options.description: A list of required macro libraries that are needed to compile the PSB source. These libraries will be used as the sys_lib at compile time.
